entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Anil And 6 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Jawahir Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Satish Kumar Tyagi
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

Heard Sri Jawahir Yadav, learned counsel for the applicants who are seven in number and Sri
Rajiv Tripathi, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as Shri Satish Kumar Tyagi.

2.  The applicant herein has filed the present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding against the applicants challenging the summoning order dated 07.01.2023 passed by the learned Civil Judge (J.D.)/Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 7, Bulandshahr under Section 147, 148, 452, 323, 324, 504, 506, 392 IPC, Police Station Sikandrabad, District Bulandshahr as well as entire proceedings of Complaint Case No. 13097 of 2022 (Sonu Yadav v. Anil and Others).
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the entire proceedings sought to be lodged pursuant to the complaint case and the summoning order dated 07.01.2023 is nothing but a concocted story just in order to implicate the applicants who are seven in number, he further submits that the applicant herein is the husband and the opposite parties are the faction of the wife.
He submits that an application under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act for Restitution of the Anil And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150331915/
1

entities.text: Sonu Yadav v. Anil and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Conjugal Rights was preferred which was withdrawn, however, in order to cook up a concocted story of administrative beating, the applicants have been implicated.
He further submits that there is also an FIR dated 05.01.2023 lodged by the wife under Sections 498A, 323, 354, 376, 511 of IPC, being FIR No. 0013 of 2023.

4. Learned counsel for the complainant as well as learned AGA on the other hand submit that the nature of the injuries are the grievous one and there are eight injuries that too near the eye area,
they further submits that offences are made out from the complaint itself and there is nothing.

5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and gone through the records, in the opinion of the Court, in view of the nature of the allegations made in the complaint as well as the fact that there is no jurisdictional error committed by the Court below as pointed out by the learned counsel for the applicants, this Court cannot go into the factual issues and venture around the same as the same is not appropriate to be done at the present stage.
6. Accordingly, the present application stands consigned to record.

7. However, needless to point out that it is always open for the applicant to prefer appropriate application before the court below seeking bail/discharge which this Court has no reason to disbelieve the same will be dealt with most expedition.

Order Date :- 5.6.2024 A. Prajapati  Anil And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150331915/
